mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_PASSWORD FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT tur.USER_ID, tr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_GROUP, tr.ROLE_NM, tr.ORDERS FROM tb_ROLE tr JOIN tb_USER_ROLE tur ON tur.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE USER_ID = #{userid}

SELECT tum.MENU_CODE, tum.MENU_NM, tum.DEPTH, tr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM, tr.ROLE_GROUP FROM tb_user_menu tum JOIN tb_menu_role tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE tr.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND DEPTH = 1 AND tum.USE_ADMIN = 'N' ORDER BY tum.MENU_CODE

SELECT tum.MENU_CODE, tum.MENU_NM, tum.DEPTH, tum.PARENT_CODE, tum.PATH, tr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM, tr.ROLE_GROUP FROM TB_USER_MENU tum JOIN TB_MENU_ROLE tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE PARENT_CODE IN (SELECT tum.MENU_CODE FROM TB_USER_MENU tum JOIN TB_MENU_ROLE tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr on tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE DEPTH = 1) AND tr.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND tum.USE_ADMIN = 'N' ORDER BY tum.MENU_CODE
SELECT USER_ID, USER_PASSWORD, USER_NM, PHONE_NUMBER, USER_BIRTH, USER_GENDER, MEMBERSHIP FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
